instruction.text: Select the different types of exercise.
What do these different types of exercise have in common?

feedback.end: Exercising regularly is essential to keeping a healthy lifestyle. Physical movement strengthens our bones, muscles and organs, while also giving us a mental boost!

b.sound: they all involve sitting down in a static position

instruction.text: Decide whether these activities use up high or low amounts of energy. Drag them to the correct group.

feedback.finish: When we do physical activities that require energy, oxygen is transported around the body to the muscles that are being used. Over time, this makes the circulatory and respiratory systems perform better.

instruction.text: Match each benefit of exercising to its picture.

feedback.end: Exercising regularly leads to increased strength of the bones and muscles. This improves movement, balance and coordination in everyday life.
Physical activity is very important for keeping your heart, blood vessels and lungs healthy. This is because the muscles demand an efficient supply of oxygen during exercise.
Using up energy during exercise encourages better quality rest and sleep.
Exercise helps to reduce stress and triggers the release of endorphins, which are chemicals in the brain that make us feel joyful.

instruction.text: Decide who has a healthier after-school routine.

feedback.end: Orla’s after-school plans involve more physical exercise, which means that her heart, lungs, muscles and bones are being strengthened and looked after.

atoms.a:
Louis comes home from school in the car and plays video games until dinner.

Orla cycles home from school and plays football with her friends in the park.

instruction.text: Orla also goes to a dance class at the weekends. Sort the steps of her routine to prevent injury into the correct order.

feedback.end: Stretching before and after exercise prevents muscles from tearing and becoming sore. It is also important to stay hydrated and keep the body cool while moving!

atoms.sound: Regular exercise benefits both our physical and mental health.

atoms.a: Before exercising, it is important to ...
atoms.b: warm up and stretch our muscles.
atoms.sound: Before exercising, it is important to warm up and stretch our muscles.

atoms.b: perform better when we exercise frequently.
